hero.label: Get involved
hero.title: Help build hope in Ward 6
hero.sub: This campaign is neighbors talking to neighbors. There is a place for you, whether you have one hour or ten.

dates.label: Key dates
dates.title: Mark your calendar
dates.d1_text: Candidates file their petitions with the Aurora City Clerk, 8am to 5pm.
dates.d2_text: The first vote, and the one that matters most. The primary narrows the field and decides who goes on to April.
dates.d3_text: The consolidated general election. Ward 6 makes its final choice.

petition.label: The petition drive
petition.title: Getting on the ballot starts with neighbors
petition.p1: To get on the ballot, Cassandra needs signatures from registered Ward 6 voters. We gather them now and file them with the City Clerk during the filing window, October 19 to 26, 2026.
petition.p2: Signing takes a minute. Carrying a clipboard takes a few hours, and it is one of the best ways to meet your neighbors.
petition.s1_text: If you are a registered Ward 6 voter, add your name.
petition.s2_text: Collect signatures on your block, at a gathering, or at your door.
petition.s3_text: Share the campaign with one friend in Ward 6 this week.
petition.note1: [TO CONFIRM] Exact number of signatures required
petition.note2: [TO CONFIRM] Petition drive schedule and locations

form.label: Sign up
form.title: Join the team
form.intro: Tell us a little about yourself and how you would like to help. A real person will write back.
form.note: This opens your email app with your details ready to send.
form.error: Please add your name and email so we can reach you.
form.thanks_text: Please check your email app. Your sign-up is ready, so just press send and we will be in touch soon.

actions.label: Ways to help
actions.title: Six ways to build hope
actions.a1_text: Talk with neighbors on their porches. It is the heart of this campaign.
actions.a2_text: Reach Ward 6 voters from your couch, on your own time.
actions.a3_text: Invite friends and neighbors over. Cassandra will come and listen.
actions.a4_text: Show your block that Ward 6 has a choice.
actions.a5_text: Help us reach Spanish-speaking neighbors in their own language.
actions.a6_text: Every gift helps us reach more Ward 6 residents.

fund.label: Powered by neighbors
fund.title: Chip in to build hope
fund.text: This campaign is powered by everyday people, like yourself, and NOT corporations.
